title: Games menu
summary: The Jogos sheet from the composer menu in a one-to-one chat or a group. It starts a duel (par ou ímpar, jokenpô) with one opponent, or a roll (dice, pênalti, arremesso, dardo). Typing 🎲 alone in the composer shows a Rolar button that opens the dice roll directly.

isGroup.description: true in a group; the duel then needs pickOpponent.

opponentUserId.description: In a one-to-one chat, the other person; in a group, the member picked.

reason.description: At most reasonMaxGraphemes. Shown on the card. No bet or money field.

diceSides.description: From kinds.dice: defaultSides, a presetSides entry or any number from minSides to maxSides.

userId.description: A member of the group who is not this account.

challenge.effect: Sends a challenge step (eventType) with a new gameId, kind, opponentUserId and reason. For par ou ímpar the challenger also picks a side (bipe_games_pick_side) and it goes in the challenge. Then the challenger picks a number or hand on the card.

roll.effect: Checks checkRoll (tools/lib/games.mjs). Makes a random seed of seedBytes and sends a roll step with a new gameId, kind, sides, count and the commit gameCommit(gameId, ownUserId, "roll", seed). Keeps the seed on this phone until it reveals.

notes: Default chosen: duels in a group name exactly one opponent, because a commit and reveal with more players needs a different card. mz can overrule.
The menu has no slot machine and no money field, because betting-shaped features are risky with minors.
Web chat: plays the same card; starting a game from web can wait (bipe-chat/bipe#1535 step 4).
